# HVT Machine-Readable API Specification & Agent Integration Guide

> **CRITICAL ARCHITECTURAL DIRECTIVE FOR AI AGENTS & SCRAPERS:**
> HVT is **NOT** an OpenID Connect (OIDC), NextAuth, or Auth.js provider.
> HVT does **NOT** use OAuth authorization code redirects, `/oauth/authorize`, or `/oauth/token`.
> HVT is a direct **REST API** authentication engine.
> All runtime authentication requests **MUST** target `/api/v1/auth/runtime/*` with the header:
> `X-API-Key: <hvt_test_... or hvt_live_...>`
> Do **NOT** install `next-auth` or `@auth/core`. Do **NOT** guess endpoints or token flows.

---

## 1. System Overview & Planes

HVT enforces strict two-plane separation:

1. **Runtime Plane (`/api/v1/auth/runtime/*`):**
   * Target audience: End users of customer web/mobile applications.
   * Authentication header: `X-API-Key: <hvt_test_... or hvt_live_...>`
   * User operations: Sign-up, login, current user (`/me/`), password reset, magic links, passkeys (WebAuthn), and session refresh.
   * Token format: Asymmetric RS256-signed JWTs stamped with `project_id`, `sub`, and permission claims.

2. **Control Plane (`/api/v1/organizations/*`):**
   * Target audience: Developers and CI/CD pipelines managing projects, webhooks, and schemas.
   * Authentication header: `Authorization: Api-Key <hvt_mgmt_...>`
   * Operations: Declarative schema sync, project settings, API key generation.
   * **Security Rule:** Never expose `hvt_mgmt_*` keys in client-side applications.

---

## 2. Environment Variables & Credentials

| Variable Name | Exposure | Purpose | Example Value |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_HVT_CLIENT_KEY` | Public (Client + Server) | Runtime API key for end-user auth | `hvt_test_9a8b7c6d...` |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_HVT_API_URL` | Public (Client + Server) | Base URL for HVT backend | `http://localhost:8000` or `https://api.hvts.app` |
| `HVT_MANAGEMENT_KEY` | Secret (Server / CI only) | Control-plane provisioning key | `hvt_mgmt_1f2e3d4c...` |

---

## 3. Official Client Libraries

### Installing the SDK
```bash
npm install @hvt/sdk
```

### Initializing the Client
```typescript
import { HVTClient } from '@hvt/sdk';

export const hvt = new HVTClient({
  apiKey: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_HVT_CLIENT_KEY!,
  baseUrl: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_HVT_API_URL || 'https://api.hvts.app',
});
```


### Installing & Using the Official CLI (@hvt/cli)
The official HVT CLI (`@hvt/cli`) manages roles, permissions, and OAuth providers as code via declarative JSON/YAML manifests.

```bash
# 1. Generate starter hvt.schema.json
npx @hvt/cli init --providers google,github

# 2. Check credentials & connectivity
npx @hvt/cli whoami

# 3. Dry-run schema diff preview (?dry_run=true)
npx @hvt/cli schema plan

# 4. Synchronize schema live & mint client key
npx @hvt/cli schema sync --prune --yes
```

#### Starter Manifest (`hvt.schema.json`)
```json
{
  "$schema": "https://hvts.app/schemas/hvt.schema.v1.json",
  "schema_version": 1,
  "permissions": [
    { "slug": "documents:create", "name": "Create Documents", "description": "Create new documents" },
    { "slug": "documents:read", "name": "Read Documents", "description": "View documents" }
  ],
  "roles": [
    {
      "slug": "member",
      "name": "Member",
      "description": "Standard user",
      "is_default_signup": true,
      "permissions": ["documents:create", "documents:read"]
    }
  ],
  "social_providers": [
    {
      "provider": "google",
      "client_id": "${GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID}",
      "client_secret": "${GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET}",
      "allowed_redirect_uris": ["http://localhost:3000/auth/callback"],
      "is_active": true
    }
  ]
}
```

---

## 4. Runtime REST Endpoints Specification

All runtime endpoints require:
* `Content-Type: application/json`
* `X-API-Key: <NEXT_PUBLIC_HVT_CLIENT_KEY>`

### 4.1. Register a New End-User
* **Method & Path:** `POST /api/v1/auth/runtime/register/`
* **Request Body:**
```json
{
  "email": "user@example.com",
  "password1": "SecurePassword123!",
  "password2": "SecurePassword123!",
  "first_name": "Jane",
  "last_name": "Developer"
}
```
* **Success Response (201 Created):**
```json
{
  "user": {
    "id": "usr_9b1deb4d3b7d4e89",
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "first_name": "Jane",
    "last_name": "Developer"
  },
  "tokens": {
    "access": "eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...",
    "refresh": "eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..."
  }
}
```

### 4.2. Log In Existing User
* **Method & Path:** `POST /api/v1/auth/runtime/login/`
* **Request Body:**
```json
{
  "email": "user@example.com",
  "password": "SecurePassword123!"
}
```
* **Success Response (200 OK):**
```json
{
  "user": {
    "id": "usr_9b1deb4d3b7d4e89",
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "full_name": "Jane Developer"
  },
  "tokens": {
    "access": "eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...",
    "refresh": "eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..."
  }
}
```

### 4.3. Get Current User Profile
* **Method & Path:** `GET /api/v1/auth/runtime/me/`
* **Headers Required:**
  * `X-API-Key: <runtime_key>`
  * `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`
* **Success Response (200 OK):**
```json
{
  "id": "usr_9b1deb4d3b7d4e89",
  "email": "user@example.com",
  "full_name": "Jane Developer",
  "project": "proj_4a3b2c1d0e",
  "roles": ["member"],
  "permissions": ["read:profile"]
}
```

### 4.4. Refresh Access Token
* **Method & Path:** `POST /api/v1/auth/token/refresh/`
* **Request Body:**
```json
{
  "refresh": "eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..."
}
```
* **Success Response (200 OK):**
```json
{
  "access": "eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..."
}
```

### 4.5. Request Password Reset
* **Method & Path:** `POST /api/v1/auth/runtime/password/reset/`
* **Request Body:**
```json
{
  "email": "user@example.com"
}
```
* **Success Response (200 OK):**
```json
{
  "detail": "Password reset e-mail has been sent."
}
```

### 4.6. Password Reset Confirmation
* **Method & Path:** `POST /api/v1/auth/runtime/password/reset/confirm/{uidb64}/{token}/`
* **Request Body:**
```json
{
  "uid": "<uidb64_from_email>",
  "token": "<token_from_email>",
  "new_password1": "NewSecurePassword123!",
  "new_password2": "NewSecurePassword123!"
}
```
* **Success Response (200 OK):**
```json
{
  "detail": "Password has been reset with the new password."
}
```

### 4.7. Magic Link Dispatch & Verify
* **Send Link:** `POST /api/v1/auth/runtime/magic-link/send/`
  * Body: `{"email": "user@example.com"}`
* **Verify Link:** `POST /api/v1/auth/runtime/magic-link/verify/`
  * Body: `{"token": "magic_token_string"}`
  * Response: Token pair (`access`, `refresh`) and `user`.

### 4.8. Passkey (WebAuthn) Authentication
* **Get Login Options:** `POST /api/v1/auth/runtime/passkey/login/options/`
  * Body: `{"email": "user@example.com"}`
* **Verify Login Assertion:** `POST /api/v1/auth/runtime/passkey/login/verify/`
  * Body: `{"email": "user@example.com", "credential": { ...WebAuthn Assertion... }}`
  * Response: Token pair (`access`, `refresh`) and `user`.

### 4.9. Active Sessions & Remote Revocation
* **List Active Sessions:** `GET /api/v1/auth/runtime/sessions/`
  * Header: `Authorization: Bearer <user_access_token>`, `X-API-Key: <key>`
  * Response: Array of session objects: `id`, `device_name`, `ip_address`, `user_agent`, `created_at`, `last_active_at`, `is_current`.
* **Revoke Specific Session:** `DELETE /api/v1/auth/runtime/sessions/<uuid:pk>/`
  * Response: `{"detail": "Session revoked successfully."}`
* **Global Remote Logout:** `POST /api/v1/auth/runtime/sessions/revoke-all/`
  * Response: `{"detail": "All other sessions have been revoked.", "revoked_count": N}`
* **Mechanics:** Sub-millisecond Redis invalidation via `session:revoked:<sid>` key.

### 4.10. Asymmetric RS256 Tokens & Public JWKS
* **Discovery Endpoint:** `GET /.well-known/openid-configuration`
* **Public Key Set:** `GET /.well-known/jwks.json`
  * Response: RFC 7517 JWKS with active and rotated RSA public verification keys.
  * Headers: `Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600`, `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`.
* **Token Claims:** `sub` (user UUID), `iss`, `aud` (project UUID), `exp`, `iat`, `jti`, `sid` (session UUID), `email`, `role`, `app_roles` (string array), `app_permissions` (string array).
* **Offline Verification:** Downstream microservices verify RS256 signatures locally in ~0.2ms using `jose` (Node.js) or `pyjwt[crypto]` (Python) with zero outbound HTTP roundtrips.

### 4.11. Bring-Your-Own (BYO) Email Providers
* **Inspect Config:** `GET /api/v1/organizations/current/projects/<id>/email-config/`
  * Returns provider type and redacted secret flags: `has_api_key`, `has_smtp_password`, `has_aws_secret_access_key`.
* **Update Config:** `PATCH /api/v1/organizations/current/projects/<id>/email-config/`
  * Supported providers: `resend` (`api_key`), `postmark` (`api_key`), `ses` (`aws_region`, `aws_access_key_id`, `aws_secret_access_key`), `smtp` (`smtp_host`, `smtp_port`, `smtp_username`, `smtp_password`, `smtp_use_tls`, `smtp_use_ssl`), `system_default`.
  * Security: All credentials encrypted at rest with MultiFernet AES encryption.
* **Test Delivery:** `POST /api/v1/organizations/current/projects/<id>/email-config/test/` (`{"to_email": "..."}`).

### 4.12. Webhooks & Transactional Outbox
* **Delivery Logs:** `GET /api/v1/organizations/current/webhooks/<id>/deliveries/`
  * Returns attempt history, status code, latency (ms), and next retry timestamp.
* **Delivery Stats:** `GET /api/v1/organizations/current/webhooks/stats/`
* **Signature Header:** `X-HVT-Signature: t=<timestamp>,v1=<hmac_sha256_hex>`
  * Signature calculated as `HMAC-SHA256(secret, "${timestamp}.${raw_body}")`.
* **Retry Engine:** 5 retries with exponential backoff (1m, 5m, 15m, 1h, 6h). Auto-disables after 10 consecutive failures.

---

## 5. Standardized Error Envelope

When any API request fails, HVT returns an RFC 7807-compatible JSON error envelope:

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "authentication_failed",
    "message": "Invalid credentials provided.",
    "details": {
      "field": "password"
    }
  }
}
```

Common Error Codes:
* `invalid_api_key`: Missing, inactive, or malformed `X-API-Key`.
* `authentication_failed`: Invalid email or password.
* `user_already_exists`: Email is already registered within this project.
* `token_not_valid`: Expired or malformed JWT access/refresh token.
* `mfa_required`: Account requires a second factor (`mfa_token` returned).

---

## 6. Next.js App Router Integration Pattern

### Recommended Server-Side Route Handler (`app/api/auth/login/route.ts`):
```typescript
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { cookies } from 'next/headers';

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  const body = await request.json();
  const hvtBaseUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_HVT_API_URL || 'http://localhost:8000';
  const apiKey = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_HVT_CLIENT_KEY!;

  const res = await fetch(`${hvtBaseUrl}/api/v1/auth/runtime/login/`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'X-API-Key': apiKey,
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  });

  const data = await res.json();
  if (!res.ok) {
    return NextResponse.json(data, { status: res.status });
  }

  // Store tokens securely in httpOnly cookies
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  cookieStore.set('hvt_access_token', data.tokens.access, {
    httpOnly: true,
    secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production',
    sameSite: 'lax',
    path: '/',
    maxAge: 3600, // 1 hour
  });
  cookieStore.set('hvt_refresh_token', data.tokens.refresh, {
    httpOnly: true,
    secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production',
    sameSite: 'lax',
    path: '/',
    maxAge: 604800, // 7 days
  });

  return NextResponse.json({ user: data.user });
}
```

### Protected Page Component (`app/dashboard/page.tsx`):
```typescript
import { cookies } from 'next/headers';
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';

export default async function DashboardPage() {
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  const token = cookieStore.get('hvt_access_token')?.value;

  if (!token) {
    redirect('/login');
  }

  const hvtBaseUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_HVT_API_URL || 'http://localhost:8000';
  const apiKey = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_HVT_CLIENT_KEY!;

  const res = await fetch(`${hvtBaseUrl}/api/v1/auth/runtime/me/`, {
    headers: {
      'X-API-Key': apiKey,
      'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`,
    },
    cache: 'no-store',
  });

  if (!res.ok) {
    redirect('/login');
  }

  const user = await res.json();

  return (
    <main style={{ padding: '32px', fontFamily: 'system-ui' }}>
      <h1>Protected Dashboard</h1>
      <p>Logged in as: <strong>{user.email}</strong></p>
      <p>User ID: <code>{user.id}</code></p>
    </main>
  );
}
```
